results.title: Pixel 11's new HiLight feature makes its flashlight noticeably dimmer than prior models
results.description: A brightness comparison shows that the Pixel 11 Pro's camera flash and torch are dimmer than those of rivals like the Galaxy Z TriFold and iPhone 17e. The likely culprit is the same diffuser that powers the HiLight notification ring, which sits directly over the main flash LED.

results.title: 21-year-old road accident victim becomes organ donor: One life lost, many lives saved through the gift of organ donation and a second chance at life
results.description: A tragic head injury led to the donation of a young woman's organs, prompting Haryana and Delhi police to create a green corridor for expedited transport. Her liver, two kidneys, and corneas were successfully transplanted, restoring hope to patients in need. This moving event underscores the urgent necessity for raising awareness about organ donation and transforming personal loss into a beacon of hope for others.

results.title: Hexaware Technologies shares rally 5%; Motilal Oswal reiterates buy with target price of Rs 720
results.description: Hexaware Technologies shares rose on Monday after Motilal Oswal reiterated its Buy rating with a Rs 720 target, implying 35% upside. The brokerage highlighted the companys AI strategy, including Zero License and token-based pricing models, while expecting delayed deal ramp-ups and AI-led opportunities to support stronger growth in CY27.
